asked: # Ways into the Breakroom + its group chat Brett (Nov 1 2026): make sure he can always get into the Breakroom and its group chat; specifically add context-menu hooks. Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md first. 1. Audit: list every existing way into the Breakroom and into its Group chat tab (app menu, nav menu, context menu, banner, home cards, deep links, keyboard, search widget). Write the list in the report. 2. Add what's missing, through the existing menu/context-menu assets and the plugin's manifest menu switches (no hard-coded menus): context menu "Open Breakroom" and "Open group chat" (global target), plus on an agent row/card "Message in group chat". Also make sure the app menu, nav menu, search widget and `axf://breakroom` + `axf://breakroom/chat` deep links reach both. 3. Entries honour UAC (hidden if the user can't see the Breakroom). Plugin-lifecycle stays green: entries live in the agent-swarm plugin's own folder and vanish on uninstall. 4. Tests + lifecycle + theme checks, phone screenshots of the context menu, short report `_claude/builds/reports/breakroom-hooks.md`, THREADS row. Commit on this branch, merge origin/main, push the branch. Do NOT push to main; Brett's session lands it with build_land. Never print secrets. Report: every way in, before and after. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, patches-web, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once.
